notes.title: A holiday in honor of the month of the game's release.
notes.notes:
Licarus, did you hear that our game is exactly one month old today, and 130 people have already bought it?

- Wow! Then we need to congratulate the players and celebrate it!!

- That's right, and therefore go get some apples for the pie.

- Okay, and how much to dial?

-Bigger, the pie should be big!

- Understood, Liara.

- Well, I want to congratulate everyone and everyone who played our game on behalf of all the characters! Thank you, you are the best! Licarus, come on, don't be lazy!
